rules: 1. Import range helpers from `../src/textStyleRanges`, `newTextElement` from `../src/newElement`, `newElementWith` from `../src/mutateElement`, `deepCopyElement` and `duplicateElement` from `../src/duplicate`, `convertToExcalidrawElements` from `../src/transform`, and `ElementsDelta` from `../src/delta`.
2. Verify pure range operations never mutate input arrays or range objects in place (NFR-2).

3. Cover clamping, empty/invalid input handling, overlap resolution with orthogonal `strokeColor` and `backgroundColor`, adjacent merging, clearing via `"transparent"` and `elementStrokeColor`, edit shifting across insertions/deletions/replacements, wrapped-line run slicing, and lifecycle preservation across `newTextElement`, `newElementWith` updates (verifying both styled and unstyled `[]` text elements retain `textStyleRanges` across object spreads and JSON round-trips), `duplicateElement`, `convertToExcalidrawElements`, and `ElementsDelta`.

style_from.reason: Follow `@excalidraw/element` Vitest unit test structure and imports.

Call `duplicateElement` and `deepCopyElement` on text elements with `textStyleRanges`.

tests.name: normalizes, clamps, resolves overlaps, and merges adjacent textStyleRanges
tests.given: out-of-bounds, inverted, transparent, overlapping, and adjacent ranges on a text string
tests.expect: normalizeTextStyleRanges returns sorted, disjoint, clamped, adjacent-merged canonical ranges while preserving orthogonal strokeColor/backgroundColor properties

tests.name: applies and clears strokeColor and backgroundColor on character selections without mutating inputs
tests.given: existing ranges and a selection [start, end) with new strokeColor, backgroundColor, "transparent", or base elementStrokeColor
tests.expect: applyTextStyleRange splits partially overlapping ranges, updates only the target property, clears overrides when set to "transparent" or elementStrokeColor, and leaves input arrays unmutated

tests.name: shifts ranges accurately on text insertion, deletion, and replacement
tests.given: ranges before, inside, spanning, and after single-character and multi-character edits
tests.expect: shiftTextStyleRangesOnEdit preserves preceding ranges, shifts following ranges by delta, expands/shrinks edited ranges, and removes ranges deleted in full

tests.name: maps originalText ranges onto wrapped visual lines and runs
tests.given: multiline and soft-wrapped text lines from getWrappedTextLines with ranges spanning across soft-wrap spaces and hard newlines
tests.expect: getWrappedLineTextRuns and getTextElementLineRuns emit contiguous runs covering each line's [start, end) with matching substrings and styles

tests.name: preserves and clones textStyleRanges across newTextElement, newElementWith, JSON copy, duplicateElement, convertToExcalidrawElements, and ElementsDelta
tests.given: styled and unstyled text elements constructed with newTextElement, updated with newElementWith, serialized with JSON.stringify/parse, duplicated, converted from a skeleton, and diffed/inverted with ElementsDelta
tests.expect: newTextElement normalizes ranges and defaults to enumerable [], newElementWith and JSON round-trips preserve [] and non-empty ranges, duplicateElement clones range objects, convertToExcalidrawElements preserves ranges, and ElementsDelta applies and undoes range changes

behaviour: Verify `getWrappedLineTextRuns` and `getTextElementLineRuns` map `originalText` ranges onto wrapped lines across soft breaks, trimmed whitespace, hard newlines, and reflow.
rules: 2. Add a test verifying that a `TextStyleRange` spanning across soft-wrapped words (with discarded break-point whitespace) and hard newlines maps to the exact word substrings on each wrapped line and stays bound to the same words when `maxWidth` changes.

sites.rule: Add a test case verifying `getWrappedLineTextRuns` and `getTextElementLineRuns` across soft wraps, trimmed whitespace, hard newlines, and reflow when `maxWidth` changes.

tests.name: should map textStyleRanges onto wrapped visual line runs across soft breaks and reflow
tests.given: a text string "  Hello  World\nNext" with ranges on "Hello", "World", and spanning across the soft break
tests.expect: getWrappedLineTextRuns and getTextElementLineRuns slice each wrapped line into runs matching the exact characters at both narrow and wide maxWidth values

behaviour: Verify `resolveColorTarget` preserves element-wide and sticky-note colour targets when `editingTextElement` has no active inline range selection.
rules: 1. Add a test inside `describe("resolveColorTarget", ...)` verifying that when `editingTextElement` is set on a sticky note label without an active inline selection, both `strokeColor` and `backgroundColor` resolve to the `sticky` domain.

sites.rule: Add a test verifying `resolveColorTarget` for `backgroundColor` while editing a sticky note label without an inline selection resolves to `sticky`.

tests.name: keeps sticky background domain while editing a sticky label without an active inline range selection
tests.given: appState with editingTextElement set to a sticky note label and no active WYSIWYG substring selection

behaviour: Verify `restoreElements` defaults missing `textStyleRanges` to `[]` on legacy text elements and normalises out-of-bounds or overlapping ranges.
rules: 1. Add tests at the end of `describe("restoreElements", ...)` verifying that a legacy text element without `textStyleRanges` restores with `restoredText.textStyleRanges` equal to `[]`, and that a text element with out-of-bounds, inverted, transparent, or overlapping `textStyleRanges` restores with normalised ranges.

sites.rule: Add tests verifying `restoreElements` defaults missing `textStyleRanges` to `[]` and normalises malformed/overlapping `textStyleRanges`.

tests.name: should default missing textStyleRanges to [] on legacy text elements and normalize provided ranges
tests.given: a legacy text element without textStyleRanges and a text element with out-of-bounds, inverted, and overlapping textStyleRanges
tests.expect: restoreElements sets textStyleRanges to [] on the legacy element and normalizes/clamps the ranges on the styled element

behaviour: Integration-test WYSIWYG inline substring styling, live edit range shifting, reflow invariance, Canvas 2D run/highlight rendering, SVG `<rect>`/`<tspan>` export, clipboard copy/paste, undo/redo, duplication, and reconciliation.
rules: 1. Render `<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />` and test opening the WYSIWYG editor on a text element, selecting a substring `[start, end)` via `setSelectionRange`, and executing `actionChangeStrokeColor` and `actionChangeBackgroundColor` (as well as clicking top-pick swatches in the properties panel) to apply, split, merge, and clear (`"transparent"` and base `element.strokeColor`) inline ranges while verifying initial auto-select and collapsed caret apply element-wide / sticky-note colours (AC-1).

2. Test typing/editing in `.excalidraw-wysiwyg` (`updateTextEditor` / `fireEvent.input`) to verify `textStyleRanges` shift on insertion, deletion, and replacement before, inside, and across ranges on both the scene element and `h.state.editingTextElement` (AC-2).

3. Test changing font size (`actionChangeFontSize`), font family (`actionChangeFontFamily`), text alignment (`actionChangeTextAlign`), and bound container width to verify `textStyleRanges` are preserved and map onto newly wrapped lines (AC-3, FR-10).

4. Test `exportScene({ type: "canvas", ... })` and `exportScene({ type: "svg", ... })` in both light and dark themes (`THEME.DARK`) to verify Canvas `fillRect` highlights and per-run `fillText` calls, SVG `<rect>` highlight elements and `<tspan fill="...">` child elements, dark-mode `applyDarkModeFilter` inversion, and unchanged output for unstyled text elements (AC-4, AC-5, NFR-3, NFR-4).

5. Test clipboard copy/paste via `serializeAsClipboardJSON`, `createPasteEvent`, `parseClipboard`, and `h.app.pasteFromClipboard` on both styled and legacy unstyled text elements to verify `textStyleRanges` survives clipboard copy/paste with normalised, deep-cloned range arrays (FR-12, AC-6).
6. Test `Keyboard.undo()` / `Keyboard.redo()`, `duplicateElements`, `reconcileElements`, and `convertToExcalidrawElements` to verify `textStyleRanges` round-trip fidelity (AC-6, AC-7).

style_from.reason: Follow `@excalidraw/excalidraw` test conventions and helper imports.

uses.reason: Call `serializeAsClipboardJSON`, `createPasteEvent`, and `parseClipboard` to verify clipboard copy/paste preservation of `textStyleRanges`.

tests.name: applies, splits, merges, and clears inline strokeColor and backgroundColor ranges in WYSIWYG editor
tests.given: a text element being edited in .excalidraw-wysiwyg with an explicit substring selection [start, end)
tests.expect: actionChangeStrokeColor and actionChangeBackgroundColor update element.textStyleRanges, split/merge overlapping ranges, clear highlights on "transparent", clear ink overrides on element.strokeColor, and keep element-wide semantics on untouched initial auto-select

tests.name: shifts textStyleRanges when inserting, deleting, and replacing text in WYSIWYG editor
tests.given: a text element with textStyleRanges edited live via textarea input events
tests.expect: ranges before the edit stay unchanged, ranges after shift by delta, ranges inside expand/shrink, and ranges deleted across are removed on both scene element and appState.editingTextElement

tests.name: preserves textStyleRanges across font size, font family, text align, and container resize reflow
tests.given: a wrapped text element with textStyleRanges when font size, font family, alignment, or container width is changed
tests.expect: originalText and textStyleRanges remain intact and getTextElementLineRuns maps the ranges onto the newly wrapped visual lines

tests.name: renders styled runs and highlight rects on Canvas 2D and exports <rect> and <tspan> in SVG for light and dark themes
tests.given: a text element with strokeColor and backgroundColor ranges exported via exportScene to canvas and svg in light and dark mode
tests.expect: canvas context records fillRect for highlights and fillText for runs with dark-mode filtered colors, and SVG contains highlight <rect> nodes before <text> and <tspan fill> nodes inside <text>

tests.name: preserves and normalizes textStyleRanges across clipboard copy and paste
tests.given: styled and legacy unstyled text elements serialized with serializeAsClipboardJSON and pasted via createPasteEvent / parseClipboard / pasteFromClipboard
tests.expect: pasted text elements retain normalized textStyleRanges (and [] for legacy elements) with deep-cloned range objects

tests.name: preserves textStyleRanges across undo/redo, duplication, reconcileElements, and convertToExcalidrawElements
tests.given: a text element with textStyleRanges subjected to undo/redo, duplicateElements, reconcileElements, and skeleton conversion
tests.expect: textStyleRanges is preserved and restored across all lifecycle operations
